name: Spice Islands Industries Limited
about: Spice Islands Industries Limited engages in the business of trading branded packaged beverages, providing hospitality services, and renting electric vehicles (EVs). It provides carbonated and pulp-based drinks, including drinking water. The company also offers services for loading and boarding, such as room rentals and restaurant services, including banquet services. In addition, it engages in the edible oil business. The company was formerly known as Spice Islands Apparels Limited and changed its name to Spice Islands Industries Limited in April 2024. Spice Islands Industries Limited was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Mumbai, India.
